title: Inaugural "Spirit of Giving" art fundraiser collaboration combines art and giving back - NewsBreak
text:
By Jeff Hinkle No media credit provided. ,
11 hours ago
GRAND JUNCTION, Colo. ( KREX ) – The Art Center of Western Colorado and Community Hospital teamed up to help raise some funds for Grand Valley Oncology.
All of the proceeds from the event are going towards supporting cancer patients in the Grand Valley, so not only are you getting a beautiful piece of artwork, but you are helping out those who are going through one of the hardest times in their lives.
“So Community Hospitals Grand Valley Oncology supports cancer patients not only locally but throughout the region,” said Karen Martsolf from Community Hospital. “We have a lot of cancer patients who travel from outside of the area to receive cancer treatment here at Grand Valley Oncology. So it will run the gambit of ways that we can support, whether it’s through our gas and lodging program for patients coming from out of the area or just with other expenses to help ease that burden.”
The night started with a silent auction, and up for grabs were things like a hand knitted sweater, or a couple of baskets with some local wine.
Then after that, the live auction saw ten pieces of local art be auctioned off, again all for a good cause.
The fundraiser is just in its inaugural year, and according to Martsolf, getting things off the ground was pretty simple, despite some little hiccups here and there.
“I think all things considered, it was pretty smooth sailing for our first year trying this event. There is always those little glitches that happen behind the scenes, but we’re very proud of the team effort and everything that came in to support this wonderful event.”
